​Sunrise Ag Coop is located in central Minnesota and has four locations and a feed mill to serve your farm needs. We have hardware, livestock supplies, fencing supplies, animal health products, feed, tillage, twine and so much more.
Sunrise Ag offers custom feed mixing, bulk feed delivery, bulk commodities, grain hauling, grain storage and corn drying at competitive prices. We work with many different feed companies including Purina, Hubbard, Agri-King, Form-A-Feed and Vita Plus and have nutritionists on staff to help you with your animal diets.
​We purchase and pickup bulk milk from local family farms and market it through First District Association in Litchfield MN.
We repair all makes and models of lawn care equipment, ATV's, snowmobiles, and electric motors and offer sales of new lawn care equipment including Gravely, Ariens, Troy-Bilt and Stihl Equipment at our Pierz location.
​
Jason Sadlovsky
General Manager
|
​
I have been with Sunrise Ag for 20+ years, driving feed truck for my 1st 10 years and as our manager for 11+. I graduated from Pierz high school and Ridgewater College with degrees in Farm Operations and management in Dairy and Ag Business.
​We live locally in Pierz and I’m married to my wife Jennifer with 5 children Emily, Alyssa, Macy, Drew, and Kenzie.
​My main goal as manager is to treat all of my employees and patrons as fair and respectful as possible! ​
